description: This file defines the core validation logic for JWT claims, including the Validator struct, validation methods, and claim verification functions, as well as the ClaimsValidator interface.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Core struct for JWT claims validation, including configuration for time leeway, expected claims, and validation options.

methods.name: NewValidator
methods.description: Creates a new Validator instance with specified options.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs validation on provided claims, including expiration, not-before, issued-at, audience, issuer, and subject checks, as well as custom validation.

methods.name: verifyExpiresAt
methods.description: Checks if the expiration time in claims is after the current time, considering leeway.

methods.name: verifyIssuedAt
methods.description: Checks if the issued-at time in claims is before the current time, considering leeway.

methods.name: verifyNotBefore
methods.description: Checks if the not-before time in claims is before the current time, considering leeway.

methods.name: verifyAudience
methods.description: Validates the audience claim against expected audiences.

methods.name: verifyIssuer
methods.description: Validates the issuer claim against an expected issuer.

methods.name: verifySubject
methods.description: Validates the subject claim against an expected subject.
